purpose: Independent fixed-parent explicit-operation diagnosis, separate from speed search
parents: indices0..7 unchanged; pairs(0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7); every source phase, no replacement after failures
operator: explicit full-phase root crossover, source ReplaceSubtree(destination0,donor0) versus production device splice_phase_tree<true> after ordinary phase import and independent device site annotation
mapping: Enumerate compatible native slots of same nonterminal and ordinal; identify exact source-child mapping by independent host export and canonical AST/scope/fuel/constant content. Only unique mapping proceeds. Empty or ambiguous mappings stay visible failures, never choose a different source pair.
oracle: Normalize constant table order and fuel table serialization order only; preserve every AST node/scope/region/fuel charge. Independently require native grammar membership of successful GPU child, compare whole child hashes, plus invalid destination/depth guards.
limits: This diagnosis covers phase roots only. No internal-site, mutation-generator, RNG-distribution, search-space equivalence, fitness-equivalence or heldout-quality claim. Known HeadIndex source/native internal-site counts can differ.
settings: frozen protocol CPU1T/GPU and physical2048/depth24/phase1024; no search or CPU reproduction replacement. Global GPU lock for compile, input hashing, diagnosis and analysis.
failure_policy: Preserve every source/native admission/mapping/GPU rejection/mismatch/timeout/failed/budget_not_run. No resampling, hidden retry or overwrite. Diagnostic executable and library/source/input hashes recorded separately from formal timing binary.
